## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.3065 (spec 0.3052), screen at the exact 128:160 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://cdn.nieuwemobiel.nl/media/z320i_front_open_crimson_red/z320i_front_open_crimson_red-a4f4fb97.webp (newmobile.com press set, reflection cropped off)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://cdn.nieuwemobiel.nl/media/z320i_front_open_crimson_red/z320i_front_open_crimson_red-a4f4fb97.webp); specs: [gsmarena.com](https://www.gsmarena.com/sony_ericsson_z320-2006.php), [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/z320i/).
